#   #return(res)
#   cat(res,sep = "\n")

expand_child <- function(child, prefix) {
  tmpfile <- tempfile(fileext = ".Rmd")
  txt <- readLines(child)
  txt <- gsub("<<model>>", prefix, txt, fixed = TRUE)
  writeLines(txt, tmpfile)
  return(tmpfile)
}
expand_childX <- function(child, prefix) {
  tmpfile <- tempfile(fileext = ".Rmd")
  txt <- readLines(child)
  txt <- gsub("<<model>>", prefix, txt, fixed = TRUE)
  #writeLines(txt, tmpfile)
  return(txt)
}
